Mission briefing

Hi, I'm Keira. Let me tell you my story.

I'm a Communication and Multimedia Design student in Amsterdam who started out as a software developer. This is how code, design and a few countries ended up in the same story.

Next to design and code, I'm also busy with digital drawing and animation, and I make my own characters and little worlds.

Part 2 · School

School projects

Four projects from my studies. Each one starts with research, ends with working code and is ready for launch.

Animal Crossing redesign

front-end

The magic of Animal Crossing, with a serious upgrade. A website based on the official Animal Crossing site, with a completely renewed look and plenty of extra animations the original doesn't have.

Mission notes
Research
Studied the original website closely to understand its style, and looked at how to combine its charm with newer ideas and more modern animations.
Concept
Kept the base of the original, but chose new colours and typefaces for a fresh version.
Development
Rebuilt the site in HTML and CSS, then added CSS keyframes to make elements move smoothly and naturally, and JavaScript for interactive elements.
  • HTML
  • CSS keyframes
  • JavaScript
Launch site ↗

Appelcatcher

game

A game in which you catch falling apples with a basket. Move the basket with the arrow keys: every apple you catch makes the next ones fall faster. A lifebar shrinks when you miss one, and when it's empty the game ends and your score is shown.

Mission notes
Research
Looked at how similar catch games work before building my own.
Development
Built the layout with HTML and CSS, and programmed the basket movement, falling apples, score and lifebar in JavaScript.
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
Launch site ↗

Keira's Memory

game

A memory game built with HTML, CSS and mainly JavaScript. Flip cards to find as many pairs as you can. Matched pairs disappear, and the game ends when all cards are cleared.

Mission notes
Design
Designed the user interface and the layout of the game.
Research
Did research and followed tutorials on building memory games.
Development
Built the complete game, including the game rules in JavaScript.
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
Launch site ↗

Gossip Girl website

themed website

A website inspired by the look and feel of the series Gossip Girl, built from research to finished code.

Mission notes
Research
Started with in-depth research into the theme and the aesthetic of Gossip Girl, collecting online inspiration on how the show is presented visually.
Design
Designed the layout and chose colours and typography that capture the feel of the series.
Development
Programmed the full website in HTML and CSS, with clean, semantic code.
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • UI design
Launch site ↗
